definitions.explanation: Describes actions that happen many times in succession.
Describes doing something with great enthusiasm or persistence.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はしきりに{時計|とけい}を{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: He kept looking at his watch repeatedly.

examples.japanese: しきりに{電話|でんわ}が{鳴|な}っている。
{彼女|かのじょ}はしきりに{私|わたし}に{留学|りゅうがく}を{勧|すす}めた。
examples.english: She eagerly kept recommending that I study abroad.

notes:
Often implies that the action is noticeable or somewhat excessive. Can have either a neutral or slightly negative nuance depending on context.

PATTERNS:
・しきりに〜する (to do something repeatedly)
・しきりに〜を{求|もと}める (to persistently seek something)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{頻繁|ひんぱん}に is more formal and neutral
・{何度|なんど}も emphasizes the number of times
・しきりに adds a nuance of persistence or eagerness
